profile.text: Rangers serves on Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4. A longtime veteran, he has traveled to many different places prior to serving in Rhodes Island's reserves. An expert archer, he still retains the characteristic agility and vigor of the Savras despite his advanced age.
